description: Frankfort, KY – December 14, 2023: Kentucky educator William “Woody” Zorn filed paperwork today to run for State Representative in Kentucky’s 36th District. Zorn’s grandfather, Wilson Wyat, was the Mayor of Louisville in the early 1940s before joining the Truman Administration as the United States Housing Expediter for the Office of War Mobilization. He later served as the 43rd Lt. Governor of Kentucky under Gov. Bert Combs. “It is not just a calling to serve the public when your grandfather is someone like Wilson Wyat, whom Governor Ned Breathit called the “Number-One Citizen” of Kentucky. For our family, public service runs in our blood,” Zorn said.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Zorn for State Representative
title: Zorn Launches Campaign for Kentucky State Representative in Kentucky’s 36th District - Zorn for State Representative
